name: Olympic Mons intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

m2.say: Every flare wake bends the same direction — out past the belt. Heavy freighter convoys running dark, all vectored at Jupiter. Somebody out there is drinking sunlight by the tanker-load.

m3.say: PASSING THROUGH? This is the tallest peak humans have ever stood on. Show some respect. ...Though between us, it's the sky that worries me now, not the summit.

m1.say: Halt! State your business at Olympic Mons Garrison. ...Oh. You're the flare investigator the Capitol wired about. At ease, everyone.

options.label: Casual
options.text: Just passing through. Big mountain you've got.

m5.say: Take these pitons, Low-G rated. If you're climbing into Jupiter's mess, you'll want grip. Garrison's honor: come back with answers.
